'''Trendivar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. A skirmish occurred here between the forces of the [[Vanderijar]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] of [[Grim Destiny]].
